title: Northstar Workspace — Supported file formats and size
text: Supported file formats are PDF, DOCX, TXT and Markdown. The maximum file size is 25 MB, so each uploaded file must be 25 MB or smaller. Image-only PDFs require OCR before ingestion.

title: Northstar Workspace — Roles
text: A workspace has three roles: Viewer, Editor and Owner. Viewers can search and read answers. Editors can upload and replace documents. Only Owners can delete a workspace or change retention settings.

title: Northstar Ingestion — Sync schedule
text: Connected folders are checked every 15 minutes. New or changed files enter the ingestion queue. A failed file is retried three times with exponential backoff before it moves to the review queue.

title: Northstar Ingestion — Chunking
text: Text is split by document headings first, then by paragraph boundaries. Chunks overlap by one paragraph. Every chunk keeps document ID, section heading, source version and page or row location when available.

title: Northstar Retrieval — Hybrid search
text: Search combines lexical ranking for exact terms with semantic ranking for paraphrases. The two rankings are fused, then results are diversified by source so one document does not dominate the answer context.

title: Northstar Retrieval — Citations
text: Every factual answer must cite at least one retrieved evidence chunk. A citation is correct only when the cited chunk directly supports the associated claim. If no retrieved evidence supports an answer, the assistant must abstain.

title: Northstar Security — Access control
text: Retrieval applies workspace membership and document access rules before ranking. Restricted chunks never enter the candidate set for an unauthorized user. Permission checks apply to lexical and semantic search.

title: Northstar Security — Retention
text: Deleted document content remains in the recovery queue for 30 days and is then permanently removed. Owners may shorten the retention period but cannot extend it beyond 30 days.

title: Northstar Operations — Latency objective
text: The demo service measures latency from request receipt until answer and citations are ready. Its evaluation objective is p95 latency below 2,000 milliseconds for the synthetic corpus.

title: Northstar Operations — Monitoring
text: Each request records retrieval duration, generation duration, cited chunk IDs, abstention status and failure code. Alerts trigger when five consecutive requests fail or p95 latency exceeds the objective for ten minutes.

title: Northstar Operations — Failure taxonomy
text: Failures are classified as RETRIEVAL_MISSING, RETRIEVAL_IRRELEVANT, ANSWER_UNGROUNDED, ANSWER_INCOMPLETE, CITATION_MISMATCH or LATENCY_EXCEEDED. The report keeps the failed layer and the next investigation step.

title: Northstar Quality — Human review
text: A human reviewer examines high-risk answers before any external side effect. The reviewer may approve, edit or reject the proposed action. The decision, timestamp and reason are stored in an audit record.
